name: Recursive rules
definition: A recursive rule says how to get the next term from the ones before it, without giving a formula. To answer, you generate terms until you reach the one asked for, or until the sequence starts repeating.
recognizeWhen: each term is the sum of the two before it
the next number is double the last one minus three
start with two and apply the rule repeatedly
misconceptions: I looked for a single formula when the rule was meant to be applied step by step.
I made an arithmetic slip early and every later term was wrong.
I did not notice that the sequence had started repeating.
